verdict.rationale: The evidence documents the v3 Mail Send endpoint (POST /v3/mail/send) and dynamic templates. Nothing in the pack shows multiple personalized messages being sent in a single request, and nothing shows per-message status returned in the response. Generic 'send email at scale' language and template versioning are adjacent, not the batch-send capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send a batch of personalized emails in a single API request with per-message status in the response, instead of looping one call per recipient
